Job Description

The trucking industry is the backbone of the global economy. More than 70% of what we consume in the U.S. is moved by trucks. Those trucks are powered by over 3.5 million drivers per year and create over $700B in annual revenue. Trucking is a massive industry but it is a traditional industry and like many traditional industries, it is ripe for innovation.

CloudTrucks is building the operating system for trucking and is the first platform specifically designed to empower truck drivers. Our all-in-one, “business in a box” solution optimizes and automates operations and accelerates cash-flow for drivers, so they can focus on building their business.

The Marketplace team at CloudTrucks tackles complex challenges with smart solutions in market prediction, pricing, and route optimization. We utilize data from myriad sources, including IoT, supply and demand-side financial & market transactions, economic time series, and user behavior streams. Given our unique position in the market at the intersection of shippers, carrier, and brokers our goal is to help drivers maximize profit and quality of life through the power of machine learning and AI.

As an ML Engineer, you will own ML models and algorithms end-to-end for solving customer problems. You will also lead architecture decisions and guide technical strategy towards innovative and pragmatic solutions which bias us towards a superlative customer experience.

Examples of projects that you may work on
• Build an intelligent dispatching tool that proactively identifies and books ideal loads for drivers given their preferences
• Automate a bidding system to attain high paying spot shipper loads at above market rates
• Implement a scheduling framework that predicts market shifts and guides drivers towards optimal routes
• Develop a negotiation AI that wins loads at the best possible price for drivers
• Design a load rating index that helps drivers identify the best loads for them

Responsibilities
• Design, implement, iterate, and manage ML models and algorithms end-to-end to solve customer problems
• Design, grow and operate our machine learning architecture prioritizing ease of use and automation
• Make judicious build vs buy decisions for our current modeling needs while preparing for 10x data volume as we rapidly scale
• Promote operational best practices for non-ML data products

What we are looking for
• Strong technical background, including 4+ years of industry experience as an ML Engineer working on production systems
• Self-motivated and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with a strong sense of ownership and an ability to drive a project from start to finish
• Takes a user-focused approach, shipping incrementally with rapid iterations
• Strong communication and collaboration skills. As a small engineering team, we work closely with each other and other cross functional teams across the company
• Experience with ML solutions, data analysis technologies, and system design

Nice to haves
• Data engineering experience
• Experience with our technical stack: Vertex AI, Qwak, LLMs, Airflow, Python, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Django

A Bit About Our Culture

We value high autonomy, ownership, and delivering results - in short - whatever it takes to set our customers up for success. We encourage each other to push the envelope, execute quickly, and be resilient to failure. We also work occasional late nights or weekends to deliver an above-and-beyond customer experience, while respecting and celebrating each other's personal background, values and commitments. In return, we are well compensated, take pride in seeing outsized impact to our product, and have memorable experiences learning and growing alongside a truly exceptional set of peers.

About CloudTrucks

CloudTrucks is a virtual trucking carrier in the multi-billion dollar trucking space. Core to this industry are over 3.5M truck drivers. They move more than 70% of all goods transported around the U.S., yet operate in a highly fragmented industry with huge opportunities for products, services and automation. We strive to deliver solutions that help truck drivers operate with much greater efficiency, increase their revenue, and offload business complexity. We are looking for uniquely exceptional people to join us on our journey as we massively scale into an industry-defining business.

Chewy is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer III to join our Merchandising Data Science Team. In this role, you will combine an understanding of machine learning, advanced data analysis, statistical testing, and software development. As a Machine Learning Engineer III, you will play a crucial part in designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning models to solve complex problems for our Retail Operations business partners. The ideal candidate will operate as a full stack data scientist who should have expertise in both machine learning and cloud technologies, with a focus on deploying and scaling machine learning models in cloud environments. In this role, they will have the opportunity to design and develop backend ML frameworks best suited for different business problems and build engineering pipelines to streamline model deployment.

• Design, develop, and implement machine learning models for various applications, including but not limited to predictive analytics, natural language processing, and computer vision.
• Research and implement state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms to address specific business challenges.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
• Document code, algorithms, and processes to facilitate knowledge sharing and ensure reproducibility.
• Provide technical guidance in best practices for model development and deployment to the data science team.
• Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you'll need:
• Candidate must possess a Graduate Degree (MS/PhD) in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or related discipline.
• 7+ years of experience in developing and deploying advanced machine learning models and algorithms in a production environment.
• Strong understanding of statistical analysis, machine learning, and deep learning techniques.
• Expertise in programming languages such as Python.
• Advanced proficiency with SQL
• Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS.

• Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

The University of Virginia seeks applicants for a Deep Learning Research Scientist to join the Research Computing team. Deep Learning, and AI in general, are used in research for multiple disciplines. As a member of the Research Computing team, you will support research projects in a variety of disciplines by developing and applying innovative deep-learning algorithms to large datasets.

RC is within UVA Information Technology Services (ITS) at UVA. ITS is a phenomenal place to lead, grow, and deliver impact. It's an organization that values results and teamwork. The team strives to create a welcoming, supportive workplace in an agile group where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and share ideas. We embrace a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. ITS values work-life balance and provides flexible work location options where possible. Please see additional information about joining our team .

What You'll Do

You will work with researchers at the University to apply artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL) to the researchers’ data. Where applicable, you may develop new algorithms for DL. You should have a solid knowledge and understanding of AI methods for applications, such as generative AI, large language models, computer vision, image and video processing, speech recognition, and speech enhancement. You will work as part of a team on the application of AI/ML/DL systems and algorithms, as well as the implementation, and the optimization or parallelization of the algorithms on our high-performance cluster (HPC).

Location: Hybrid, working onsite at our Charlottesville office as needed.

As a staff member of the Data Analytics Center, you will provide the following support to UVA faculty:
• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to apply AI solutions to complex research problems.
• Oversee and manage your efforts on AI-based projects, ensuring timely completion and scientific rigor.
• Prepare presentations and technical reports that reflect your results.

Also, within the Data Analytics Center, you will have the opportunity to
• Research and develop algorithms (as needed to support faculty) for AI/ML/DL systems, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), diffusion models, neural rendering, speech or vision processing.
• Provide training and workshops on AI and deep learning techniques for the university community.
• Mentor and guide junior researchers and team members in AI methodologies.
• Optimize AI algorithms and neural networks for our HPC system, which may include parallel implementations.
• Stay current on the latest developments in AI and machine learning.

Required Qualifications:
• An advanced degree and at least 5 years of related work experience
• Proven expertise in AI systems and learning algorithms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and writing skills.
• Inclusive - you are able to adapt to working with diverse researchers and disciplines.
• • vid learner - you demonstrate curiosity and persistence when faced with challenging projects and actively explore new ideas or approaches.
• Collaborative - you are able to build relationships with researchers and our team members, offering support and welcoming new approaches.

Preferred Qualifications
• PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related field with a focus on AI/DL.
• 10-20 years of experience in research.
• Solid understanding of AI applications such as generative AI, LLMs, computer vision, and speech processing.
• Coding skills in popular deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.

Anticipated Hiring Range: $140,000 - $160,000 / annual

The selected applicant will be required to complete a background check prior to their first day of employment per university policy.

We build technology to find smarter ways to connect shippers with carriers while solving some of the toughest problems in the 800-billion-dollar freight industry. We also forecast business metrics, evaluate the causal impact of business decisions, design statistical and machine learning models to optimize our product, and leverage our data to generate insights for our customers. The breadth of the problem space is huge, spanning machine learning, optimization, causal inference, experimental design, econometrics, and prediction domains. We have only begun to dig into the difficult and diverse problems in our two-sided marketplace. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Machine Learning Scientist to take ownership of our marketplace, design an innovative auction system, determine optimal price points, and engage in designing the auction for feedback. Technical Problem Solving: Ability to frame business problems as automated decision solutions and contribute as a technical leader on our collaborative teamsIntelligent but practical; you want to get things done and love simplicity.A plus if you have experience in two-sided marketplaces, financial markets and economic theory.A plus if you have experience in developing mature models and doing the tough research work to unlock value.Successful Convoyagers share these traits:We’re passionate about solving complex problems, and get excited about diving deep to understand an issue.We aren’t defined by our titles, we do what’s needed to prioritize our customers.We support others through change and uncertainty, and stay the course when things get challenging.We believe in our mission, and the potential for impact in our space.Pay & Benefits:The salary for this role in the state of Washington is between $142,300 and $224,900. Grainger is hiring Applied Machine Learning Scientist

Work Location Type: Hybrid

About Us:

As a leading industrial distributor with operations primarily in North America, Japan, and the United Kingdom, Grainger serves more than 4.5 million customers worldwide. We deliver products through innovative technology and deep customer relationships. With 2023 sales of $16.5 billion, we are dedicated to providing value for customers, fostering an engaging culture for team members, and driving strong financial results.

Our welcoming workplace enables you to learn, grow, and make a difference by keeping businesses running and their people safe. As a 2024 Glassdoor Best Place to Work and a Great Place to Work-Certified company, we're looking for passionate people to join our team as we continue leading the industry over our next 100 years.

Responsibilities:
• Work with a team of product managers, data scientists, data engineers, and architects to build targeted products that help customers solve and answer specific problems.
• Utilize code (Python, SQL) for analyzing and building ML models to solve business problems.
• Build, test, and deploy customer-facing analytical and ML endpoints & APIs that are a mixture of business logic, model, and data.
• Collaborate with researchers, software developers, and business leaders to define product requirements and provide analytical support.
• Identify customer needs to tailor and scale ML solutions effectively.
• Articulate concepts and generate visual representations of the data product.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a field such as Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Experience building solutions with SQL and Python.
• Experience with wrapping models in C/Python code and serving them as REST APIs.
• Relevant work experience in an analytical role involving data extraction, analysis, and communication of findings.
• Experience deploying models into the cloud with tooling like Docker & Kubernetes.
• Experience automating data augmentation and refresh using Airflow and Bash Scripting.
• Ability to effectively communicate technical solutions to engineering teams and business audiences.

Rewards and Benefits:

With benefits starting day one, our programs provide choice and flexibility to meet team members' individual needs. Check out the highlights below and review all our benefits at Grainger.
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance plans and 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist to support your emotional wellbeing.
• Paid time off (PTO) and 6 company holidays per year.
• 6% company contribution to a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no match required.
• Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing, and free access to financial counseling, education, and tools.
• Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Accommodation Statement:

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment that includes both providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the application and hiring process as well as throughout the course of one's employment. With this in mind, should you need a reasonable accommodation during the application and selection process, please advise us so that we can provide appropriate assistance.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer

As a Capital One Machine Learning Engineer (MLE), you'll be part of an Agile team dedicated to productionizing machine learning applications and systems at scale. You’ll participate in the detailed technical design, development, and implementation of machine learning applications using existing and emerging technology platforms. You’ll focus on machine learning architectural design, develop and review model and application code, and ensure high availability and performance of our machine learning applications. You'll have the opportunity to continuously learn and apply the latest innovations and best practices in machine learning engineering.

What you’ll do in the role:
• The MLE role overlaps with many disciplines, such as Ops, Modeling, and Data Engineering. In this role, you'll be expected to perform many ML engineering activities, including one or more of the following:
• Design, build, and/or deliver ML models and components that solve real-world business problems, while working in collaboration with the Product and Data Science teams.
• Inform your ML infrastructure decisions using your understanding of ML modeling techniques and issues, including choice of model, data, and feature selection, model training, hyperparameter tuning, dimensionality, bias/variance, and validation).
• Solve complex problems by writing and testing application code, developing and validating ML models, and automating tests and deployment.
• Collaborate as part of a cross-functional Agile team to create and enhance software that enables state-of-the-art big data and ML applications.
• Retrain, maintain, and monitor models in production.
• Leverage or build cloud-based architectures, technologies, and/or platforms to deliver optimized ML models at scale.
• Construct optimized data pipelines to feed ML models.
• Leverage continuous integration and continuous deployment best practices, including test automation and monitoring, to ensure successful deployment of ML models and application code.
• Ensure all code is well-managed to reduce vulnerabilities, models are well-governed from a risk perspective, and the ML follows best practices in Responsible and Explainable AI.
• Use programming languages like Python, Scala, or Java.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree
• At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Scala, or Java (Internship experience does not apply)
• At least 3 years of experience designing and building data-intensive solutions using distributed computing
• At least 2 years of on-the-job experience with an industry recognized ML frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch, Dask, Spark, or TensorFlow)
• At least 1 year of experience productionizing, monitoring, and maintaining models

Preferred Qualifications:
• 1+ years of experience building, scaling, and optimizing ML systems
• 1+ years of experience with data gathering and preparation for ML models
• 2+ years of experience developing performant, resilient, and maintainable code
• Experience developing and deploying ML solutions in a public cloud such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
• Master's or doctoral degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics, or a similar field
• 3+ years of experience with distributed file systems or multi-node database paradigms
• Contributed to open source ML software
• Authored/co-authored a paper on a ML technique, model, or proof of concept
• 3+ years of experience building production-ready data pipelines that feed ML models
• Experience designing, implementing, and scaling complex data pipelines for ML models and evaluating their performance

job_description:
About Treeswift:

Treeswift is revolutionizing land monitoring and management with cutting-edge robotics and machine learning that upends how humans connect to landscapes. Treeswift delivers high-quality data at unprecedented scale to a wide range of industry stakeholders including but not limited to some of the largest U.S. timber operations, innovative carbon credit developers, and major utilities managing vegetation around critical infrastructure. Treeswift’s team brings together robotics experts from top academic institutions, innovative forestry professionals and deep experience in enterprise software development in order to become the global leader in landscape data. Our data empowers our partners to prevent wildfires, have accurate and reliable carbon credits, and create sustainable timber products that drive our economy.

About the Role:

Treeswift is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Machine Learning Computer Vision Software Engineer to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in developing and deploying state-of-the-art computer vision solutions to advance our mission. We are looking for an exceptional candidate with a proven track record of training and deploying computer vision models at scale. If you are a passionate and experienced engineer eager to contribute to the future of land monitoring and management we encourage you to apply.

This is a full-time, hybrid/3-day a week in person role, based out of our NYC or Philadelphia office.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop new computer vision models that revolutionize our customers’ businesses. Whether for a utility company seeking to prevent outages from downed trees or a forest manager maximizing carbon over the long-term, Treeswift develops computer vision algorithms that upend the cost of collecting high quality forest data and radically improve decision-making for our customers. In this role you will be responsible for bringing innovative ideas and rapid execution to new and existing models. In the course of development, you will collaborate closely with other teams (product, operations etc…) and have an opportunity to interact with end-users.
• Create a best-in-class feedback loop to accelerate model development. In this role, you will be asked to improve Treeswift’s ability to assess model performance and adapt to new operating conditions at scale. You will have the unique opportunity to benchmark performance against field-collected, ground truth measurements and collaborate with in-house forestry experts.
• Help Treeswift scale. In this role you will be expected to bring prior experience with commercial computer vision model development and deployment to help Treeswift cost-effectively scale its technology to serve a growing number of customers and use cases. You will be responsible for enabling effective collaboration on model development within the engineering team, and you will contribute to efforts to ensure reliable and robust performance of models in production.

Required Skills
• Proven track record of training and deploying computer vision models at scale for commercial use cases.
• Three or more years of software industry experience.
• Experience with cloud-based technologies and distributed computing.
• Experience with image processing techniques and computer vision fundamentals.
• Experience creating, curating, and cleaning training datasets
• Strong programming skills in Python
• Expertise in deep learning libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
• Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills
• Expertise in object detection and instance segmentation demonstrated through relevant projects.
• Experience applying machine learning to video sources.
• Experience with deep learning training frameworks such as MLflow, Lightning, Weights and Biases, or similar.

What We Value
• Mission before team, team before self. This means that we value low ego team members who focus on working towards the best outcomes for the customer and the business, regardless of who gets the credit.
• Seeking the truth.
• Never being complacent. Diagnosing challenges and creatively solving big problems. Comfort with radically rethinking and reshaping how things are done today.
• Direct feedback. Feedback is a gift and always delivered with positive intent.
• Owners mindset. If you see an opportunity for improvement, run with it. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere, no matter your role.

Benefits
• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance
• Life insurance package and disability coverage
• Stock options
• Paid leave for new parents
• Unlimited PTO
• 401K

Salary

The estimated salary range for this position is $131,000-$172,000. Total compensation for this position is determined by skills, qualifications, relevant work experience, location, and other factors. This salary estimate excludes the value of any potential bonuses; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.

We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Software Product Engineering builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Software Product Engineering is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose - creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like model driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.

What You’ll Be Doing:

The Principal Software Engineer will play a pivotal role in building transformative gen AI platforms and products across the entire Lilly value chain: drug discovery, research, manufacturing, go-to-market, and general knowledge work. As part of the Software Product Engineering organization, you will provide technical leadership and contribution to our cutting-edge AI platform.

How You’ll Succeed:
• Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, promoting best practices and fostering a collaborative and delivery-oriented environment.
• Contribute to the design, development, and implementation of Gen AI platforms and products, with a focus on scalability and performance.
• Work with product and technical architect to drive forward the AI platform understanding requirements and ensuring they translate into technical deliverables.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including scientists, researchers, and business stakeholders

Your Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
• 8+ years of programming experience in languages such as Python, JS, Go and experience with Kubernetes with experience in machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and natural language processing libraries.
• 5+ years of machine learning principles and techniques, including deep learning, recurrent neural networks (RNNs), and transformer models.
• 5+ years of software engineering leadership experience, with a proven track record of delivering successful projects.

Additional Skills/Preferences:
• Up-to-date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and regulatory requirements in the life sciences and AI domains.
• Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
• Proficiency in Python with understanding of async, streaming and other concepts.
• Experience in the life sciences or regulated industries is highly preferred.
• Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models is a plus.
• Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

Additional Information:

Description

Be at the cutting edge of transforming national security analysis with artificial intelligence!

We're seeking a visionary AI Analyst to spearhead the integration of AI capabilities, including revolutionary large language models, across diverse national security challenges. As a trailblazer in the Operations and Program Analysis Group (JOP) within the National Security Analysis Department (NSAD), you'll revolutionize analytical studies by fusing AI-driven insights with physics-based modeling, gaming techniques, case studies, and operational analyses.

Pioneer a Game-Changing Capability: Generative Wargaming:

You'll take the lead in developing a groundbreaking generative wargaming capability that harnesses the power of large language models to simulate blue or red strategic decision-making scenarios. This innovative technology will reshape the way we approach national security, allowing us to anticipate and prepare for emerging threats like never before.

Unleash Your Expertise, Shape the Future:

As an AI Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to...
• Drive innovation in AI applications, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in national security analysis.
• Collaborate with renowned experts in AI, operations research, and national security to shape the future of strategic decision-making.
• Develop and refine AI-enabled tools and methodologies that will inform critical policy decisions.
• Stay at the forefront of AI advancements, ensuring our nation remains ahead of the curve in national security.

If you're passionate about harnessing AI to drive national security breakthroughs, we want to hear from you! Join our team of innovators and shape the future of national security analysis:

As an AI Analyst in the Operations and Program Analysis Group (JOP), you will be responsible for...
• Helping develop NSAD’s proficiency in working with and refining large language models across several domains.
• Applying AI enabled capabilities more broadly to NSAD analyses, including those focused on the tactical and operational use of existing and new systems and programs to support the warfighter at the Department of Defense (DoD), Service, Combatant Command, and below the Service-level.
• Playing an active role in developing ideas to expand NSAD’s application of AI and generative AI capabilities to analyses.
• Developing and maintaining effective working relationships across NSAD and the Laboratory.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you have...
• A Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, the physical sciences, or another related analytic subject area.
• Experience with fine tuning pre-trained language models to adapt them to specific domains, and the ability to design rigorous evaluation protocols and conduct model evaluation experiments.
• A strong understanding of machine learning and deep learning architectures, including transformer models, recurrent neural networks, and convolutional neural networks; proficiency in machine learning algorithms and optimization techniques.
• Skills in data pre-processing and how to handle imbalanced datasets.
• Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in AI and natural language processing (NLP), such as Python; experience with associated libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.
• Curiosity and a passion for staying up-to-date with the latest research advancements in AI and how they may apply to our problem sets.
• Ability to apply state-of-the-art techniques to solve practical problems.
• Demonstrated ability to effectively interact and collaborate with a diverse team.
• Excellent verbal and written communications skills.
• Willingness and ability to travel an estimated one or more trips per week within the Washington DC/Baltimore metropolitan area dependent upon task assignments, additional travel may be required within the US and/or overseas.
• The ability to obtain a TS/SCI clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you have...
• A Master’s degree, or Ph.D., or equivalent in mathematics, the physical sciences or another related analytic subject area.
• Experience in the analysis of tactical and operational employment of military systems that affect DoD program development.
• In-depth knowledge of NLP concepts and techniques, and experience with NLP tasks such as classification, named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, and text generation.

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The opportunity

Join Adobe Design in shaping the future of Enterprise AI tools within Experience Cloud. We're seeking a Staff Designer to pioneer the next generation of AI-driven experiences for technical enterprise users. Are you passionate about empowering teams and companies to leverage AI for transformative business outcomes? In this role, you'll lead the charge in defining the possibilities within this dynamic space.

What you’ll do

As a pivotal member of our team, you'll spearhead the design of integrated experiences that revolutionize Enterprise workflows beyond traditional Adobe toolsets. Your focus will encompass AI problem spaces, where users tackle intricate technical challenges.

In this role, you will
• Help build GenAI strategy for enterprise content creation at scale across the Experience Cloud design team and beyond.
• Simplify complexity by devising actionable plans in ambiguous scenarios.
• Collaborate with strategic partners across all Adobe clouds to craft the future positioning of enterprise workflows.
• Conceptualize design ideas through sketches, storyboards, wireframes, and prototypes, refining them based on feedback and research.
• Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and researchers to align technological capabilities with user needs.
• Work closely with senior executives, product managers, senior engineering scientists, and partners across the company to streamline product innovation
• Proactively collaborate across multiple teams to align on strategy and extend design patterns.

What you need to succeed

Must-haves:
• Proven design experience in a similar field
• Experience with at-scale workflows, automation and templatization
• A background and understanding of enterprise design
• A history of leading design for and launching complex, yet intuitive products
• College degree or equivalent practical experience in design with an emphasis on graphic design, HCI, or related design field
• Mastery of Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and other design tools such as Keynote, Sketch, or Figma
• Ability to build functional prototypes to test with users and or work closely with researchers
• Experience working iteratively with engineering teams to bring the vision to life
• Solid interpersonal, written and oral communication skills and storytelling skills
• Willingness and ability to contribute to the creative spirit of the Adobe Design team
• Excellent design craft and the ability to blend that with strong intuition for business
• A real passion for collaborating across many subject areas

Nice-to-haves:
• Prior experience working within a creative agency or an enterprise design team
• Prior experience crafting design strategy for GenAI, platform experiences, and/or systems
• Deep knowledge around and passion for accessible and inclusive design

How to apply

To be considered for this role, please submit your resume and portfolio. We’d especially like to see strong systems thinking and how your work has evolved over time.

About Adobe Design

Adobe Design creates tools that amplify the world’s ability to create and communicate. We’re a global team of designers, researchers, prototypers, content strategists, program managers, and more who work across Adobe’s three product lines: Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and Experience Cloud.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

Job Summary of Principal Generative AI Developer:

As the Principal Generative AI Developer, you will be expected to bring your knowledge of AI technology and product engineering to new heights

Capital One is at the forefront of utilizing machine learning to develop AI systems that are trustworthy, reliable, and human-centered. Capital One has built a reputation for producing intelligent, automated customer experiences in real-time, setting industry standards. Capital One's technology applications make banking more accessible, and their AI-ML systems provide a humanized touch while addressing customers' inquiries and informing them of unusual charges. Capital One is well-positioned to harness the power of AI with their investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms. The company invests in world-class applied science and engineering teams, ensuring they continue to produce breakthrough products and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. Joining Capital One allows you to pioneer emerging AI capabilities, bringing transformative benefits to their customers and revolutionizing how banking works.

In pursuit of a Principal Generative AI Developer. We require a candidate with a wealth of experience devising and maintaining APIs and SDKs, enabling scale of AI models that form a key part of our Enterprise AI team. You will be assigned to create systems that grant public access to LLMs and FMs via our cloud infrastructure, alongside a team of elite AI researchers and engineers. Our key collaboration with you will be to develop APIs for customer applications that will operate in real-time.

Responsibilities of Principal Generative AI Developer:
• Architect, construct, and implement properly-managed primary APIs and SDKs to get into our LLMs and exclusive FMs, which comprise exercises for training, refining, and promoting, and even orchestration SDKs.
• Build APIs with clear documentation and standardized protocols that support governance automation, minimizing the potential for errors and security breaches.
• Build interfaces with LLMs and FMs that integrate seamlessly into your application and provide enhanced functionality for your users.
• Allow our users to develop brand-new GenAI functionalities.
• Effective tools and processes for monitoring API access patterns and operational health will help identify potential vulnerabilities and provide prompt remedial measures.
• Implement strict governance processes that ensure AI is developed in line with ethical principles, legal regulations, and stakeholder expectations.

Basic Qualifications of Principal Generative AI Developer:
• Pursuing a four-year degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, culminating in a Bachelor's degree
• A requirement for the position is having an extensive background in designing and constructing data-driven solutions with a strong emphasis on cache optimization and distributed computing techniques that spans 6 years or more
• The company requires a professional with a minimum of 6 years of experience in coding using Java, Python, Go, or Scala
• We are seeking candidates who have experience constructing, scaling, and optimizing training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks for at least one year

Preferred Qualifications of Principal Generative AI Developer:
• Competency in building and managing AI-powered products or platforms for NLP, speech, computer vision, or recommendation systems aimed at serving massive user bases.
• Possessing the aptitude to navigate ambiguity and rapidly changing scenarios.
• If you have experience in technology and product-oriented startups, we welcome your application.
• The ability to work alongside researchers and engineers, enabling swift iterations and improvements to the product experience while building essential competencies.
• Expertise in deploying intricate neural network models in demanding production scenarios.
• Proven track record of implementing API security measures, ensuring observability, and enforcing strict cloud access control policies.

About Fluence: Fluence Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader in energy storage products and services, and optimization software for renewables and storage. With a presence in over 47 markets globally, Fluence provides an ecosystem of offerings to drive the clean energy transition, including modular, scalable energy storage products, comprehensive service offerings, and the Fluence IQ Platform, which delivers AI-enabled SaaS products for managing and optimizing renewables and storage from any provider. Fluence is transforming the way we power our world by helping customers create more resilient and sustainable electric grids.

For more information, visit our website, or follow us on LinkedIn or Twitter. To stay up to date on the latest industry insights, sign up for Fluence's Full Potential Blog.

OUR CULTURE AND VALUES

We are guided by our passion to transform the way we power our world. Achieving our goals requires creativity, diversity of ideas and backgrounds, and building trust to effect change and move with speed.

We are Leading

Fluence currently has thousands of MW of energy storage projects operated or awarded worldwide in addition to the thousands of MW of projects managed by our trading platform—and we are growing every day.

We are Responsible

Fluence is defined by its unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and integrity.

We are Agile

We achieve our goals and meet our customer’s needs by cultivating curiosity, adaptability, and self-reflection in our teams.

We are Fun

We value the diversity in thought and experience of our coworkers and customers. Through honest, forthcoming, and respectful communications we work to ensure that Fluence is an inclusive and welcoming environment for all.

ABOUT THIS POSITION

Location: Hybrid (2-3 days in office) in Arlington, VA

Fluence is seeking an intern to work with the Americas New Customer Solutions team. This role will directly create value for Fluence customers via deployment of new digital technologies into operating sites in the Americas region. These technologies aim to improve key operational metrics in the young and rapidly growing stationary storage industry. This is a significant role in a young, dynamic group inside Fluence with opportunity for high individual contribution and impact.

As a New Customer Solutions Intern, you will:

•Work on applications utilizing Fluence’s extensive fleet operating data, covering multiple GWhs and a decade in operation.

•Collaborate with senior engineers to design, develop, and maintain AI applications and services.

•Leverage large language models (LLMs) to solve pressing business needs.

•Utilize natural language processing (NLP) to extract information and ensure high data quality

•Design and refine workflows which ensure AI and ML modeling efforts are fed with data suited to purpose and need.

•Assist in cloud infrastructure design and management.

•Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices.

•Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and develop solutions.

•Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely manner.

•Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies to enhance development practices.

•Support the team with testing, deployment, and monitoring of applications.

• Has a passion for the future of energy storage and a disinterest in the status quo.
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience utilizing Python for AI/ML solutions.
• Familiarity with large language models, including fine-tuning, hyperparameter optimization, and prompt engineering.
• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services, including the AWS CLI.
• Knowledge of natural language processing techniques and tools.
• Experience using version control systems, such as Git.
• Desire to learn more about AI in the stationary energy storage domain.
• Strong problem resolution and decision-making skills, creative and resourceful, display sound judgment and demonstrate accountability.
• Ability to work in a time-sensitive and agile growth environment.
• A collaborative spirit in working across teams and functions.
• Interest in both the fundamentals of technology as well as adoption of technology by society and industry.

Well, from a technical point of view, we leverage the power of a global crowd to provide some of the world’s biggest companies with the high-quality data they need to power their artificial intelligence. We like online gaming, running marathons, and team drinks. We celebrate authenticity and diversity and we’re invested in what we do. Our mission? World domination, obviously!

About The Role

At Defined.ai, we make machines smarter for Fortune 500 companies. Our focus is on improving Artificial Intelligence technologies through natural language processing – and we need linguists to train new models. We are looking for Senior Computational Linguists for French and Italian to work on-site with one of our top end clients.

Start & completion dates:

Jun1 2024 to Jul1 2024, during which the candidates will need to finish onboarding and testing. Upon successful completion of the trial period, there will be an option to extend the contract.

Weekly scope:

40h per week (full time).

Location where work will be done:
• On-site (Seattle, WA, Westlake area) OR
• On-site (Burlingame, CA)

Compensation:

Hourly pay rate of 50$

General:

Linguists will help build out the NLU workflows and workstreams required by defining and delivering data annotation pipelines, annotation guidelines, golden datasets, training datasets, evaluation criteria, process improvements, upskilling programs, etc. You would be working on the following work streams:
• language modeling
• building test and evaluation training sets
• evaluation and analysis of product features
• rules engine, tweaking the engine for the model outputs
• triage
• multimodal features, chatbot experiences, packing the AI into glasses

Job description:

The role of the computational linguist is to help develop and improve our client’s NLP/NLU systems. Tasks may include but are not limited to:
• Annotating and reviewing linguistic data – part of speech annotation, semantic annotation, phonetic transcription
• Collect data and perform data analysis
• Labeling text for disambiguation, and (inverse) text normalization
• Evaluating current system outputs, detect incidental and systemic errors and provide solutions
• Translation and localization tasks
• Creating and evaluating training and test sets
• Prompt engineering

Minimum Requirements:
• Native speaker of the target language and fluent in English
• Experience in using, adapting and creating scripts in python
• Knowledge of relational databases and using, adapting and creating SQL queries
• Experience in annotation work
• Knowledge of semantics, syntax, morphology or lexicography
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Attention to detail and good organizational skills
• Be able to work independently with confidence and little oversight

Desired Skills:
• Degree in Linguistics or Computational Linguistics, or a degree computer science with a minor in linguistics
• Ability to quickly grasp technical concepts; learn in-house tools

About Us

Defined.ai offers a platform with multiple data delivery options that leverages machine learning technology and human intelligence to deliver quality-guaranteed training data for AI systems. The platform offers self-service and fully customizable solutions that deliver high-quality project-specific training data, enabling AI products reach market quicker. It is this business model that has allowed Defined.ai to raise a total of $63.6M in funding over 4 rounds. Our value proposition is quality, privacy, speed and scale, covering more than 50 different languages. With strong expertise in speech and natural language processing technologies, we have been serving AI companies and Fortune 500 companies since day one. Defined.ai was founded in Seattle and has offices in Lisbon, Porto and Tokyo.

(This role can be remote or hybrid role based in New York City or Redwood City or Redwood City + San Francisco)

Working alongside a team of world-class researchers and machine learning engineers, your goal will be to empower users from diverse organizations to use the Snorkel Flow platform effectively. Your key responsibilities will include developing guides, tutorials, training materials, and learning content aimed at data scientists or similar audiences, with the aim of minimizing the requirement for individualized assistance and training. About Zscaler

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so that customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange is the company’s cloud-native platform that protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

With more than 10 years of experience developing, operating, and scaling the cloud, Zscaler serves thousands of enterprise customers around the world, including 450 of the Forbes Global 2000 organizations. In addition to protecting customers from damaging threats, such as ransomware and data exfiltration, it helps them slash costs, reduce complexity, and improve the user experience by eliminating stacks of latency-creating gateway appliances.

Zscaler was founded in 2007 with a mission to make the cloud a safe place to do business and a more enjoyable experience for enterprise users. Zscaler’s purpose-built security platform puts a company’s defenses and controls where the connections occur—the internet—so that every connection is fast and secure, no matter how or where users connect or where their applications and workloads reside.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced HR AI Program Manager to join our People & Culture (P&C) team and lead our Artificial Intelligence Transformation initiatives, reporting to the Head of People Operations. In this newly created role, you will be responsible for enabling People and Culture with AI technologies, with the goal of using AI to yield materially increase customer experience, business intelligence, and efficiency when compared to other technologies. You will start by developing business cases and experiments for candidate use cases, such as talent search, job and skills catalog, insights and predictive analytics. You will then execute these experiments, measure results, and iterate to yield material business outcomes. While executing, you will educate P&C and create fluency in AI. Finally, as your AI-enabled services and products reach maturity, you will transition ownership to functional areas and operations.

You are an intellectually curious innovator with a passion for new technologies, people, and business management. You can establish and articulate a vision, but are able to execute towards a strategy in incremental steps, making appropriate investments as you gather observed data. You are willing to experiment and can fail fast, and use data to make risk-adjusted decisions. You dive deep and are willing to both lead and execute tasks to move initiatives forward. Most importantly, while you are a thought leader in AI, you are a trusted partner to P&C and can adjust to business needs, timelines, and capacity for change.

We prefer that this role is located in our office in San Jose, CA or Seattle, WA (hybrid, 2-3 days a week in office).

Responsibilities:
• Be the company expert in the most current and relevant HR AI technologies.
• Develop and continually curate AI business cases and drive initiatives to invent AI-enabled services and products for the strongest business cases.
• Create design principles and strategy for the suitable use of AI technology within P&C, inclusive of the experience, efficiency, and ethics.
• Assess performance of AI technologies using data and adjust when necessary.
• Partner with People and Culture senior leaders, program owners, and service delivery leaders to educate, evangelize, and embed AI technologies where it can add material business value.
• Work with Zscaler IT to learn from and champion AI to the company.

Minimum Qualifications:
• 10+ years of experience as an HR Technology Program Manager or a similar role.
• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Experience with implementing and operating new transformative technologies for HR.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master's degree.
• Strong knowledge of HR AI technologies, practices, and pitfalls.
• Excellent project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to leverage data to drive decision-making.

job_description:
Your work days are brighter here.

At Workday, it all began with a conversation over breakfast. When our founders met at a sunny California diner, they came up with an idea to revolutionize the enterprise software market. And when we began to rise, one thing that really set us apart was our culture. A culture which was driven by our value of putting our people first. And ever since, the happiness, development, and contribution of every Workmate is central to who we are. Our Workmates believe a healthy employee-centric, collaborative culture is the essential mix of ingredients for success in business. That’s why we look after our people, communities and the planet while still being profitable. Feel encouraged to shine, however that manifests: you don’t need to hide who you are. You can feel the energy and the passion, it's what makes us unique. Inspired to make a brighter work day for all and transform with us to the next stage of our growth journey? Bring your brightest version of you and have a brighter work day here.

About The Team

Workday’s core value of integrity is the driving force behind the Workday Integrity Team, which provides all Workmates with the knowledge and tools needed to act with integrity in all business situations, including the development of innovative and trustworthy artificial intelligence (AI) products and services. For the fourth year in a row, Workday has been named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere, a global leader in defining and advancing the standards of ethical business practice. The Responsible AI program sits within the Integrity team within Workday’s Legal, Compliance, and Corporate Affairs organization for good reason – the mission of this program is to facilitate Workday’s ambition to develop innovative and trustworthy AI and ML products that delight customers and positively impact society. This is a purposeful, high visibility program with an ambitious agenda and significant executive support.

About The Role

This is an exciting opportunity to assist with the maturation of a young but burgeoning program at Workday, Responsible AI (RAI). Workday’s dedicated RAI team is in need of an engagement and communications expert who can help build bridges to other communications, learning, and marketing experts across Workday. This team member will primarily be responsible for managing the development and execution of both customer and employee engagement and communication programs. This includes growing, engaging, and managing our network of RAI Champions across the organization.

Responsibilities
• Work with cross-functional partners to develop and maintain a message house with succinct and engaging communications that accurately represent Workday’s Responsible AI governance program
• Develop and maintain relationships with marketing and communications experts across Workday to generate continued excitement for, and ensure the accuracy of, messaging as it relates to Responsible AI at Workday
• Work with cross-functional experts and external consultants to drive the development and delivery of Responsible AI training and awareness programs
• Grow and mature Workday’s Responsible AI Champions network, developing new activities and content to increase Workmates knowledge about the program and encourage their evangelism
• Develop and maintain a program to engage customers and potential customers on Workday’s approach to Responsible AI and the company’s associated thought leadership. This includes delivering educational content for customers
• Identify public speaking and writing opportunities and draft content to highlight Workday’s Responsible AI thought leadership. Ensure consistent messaging ad alignment with general Workday messaging
• Manage internal responsible AI communications and requests for RAI assistance

About You

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree or higher. Degree in Communications, Marketing, or a related field preferred
• 6+ years experience working in product development, product marketing, and/or technical learning and development

Other Qualifications
• Expert collaboration skills including experience working with technical subject matter experts and a range of cross-functional stakeholders
• Demonstrated ability to work with technical source material, translating it into compelling and succinct messages for non-technical audiences
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Familiarity with, and a strong desire to learn more about, AI Ethics and Responsible AI concepts including risk, fairness, transparency, algorithmic monitoring and observability
• Strong critical thinking skills and respect for different perspectives with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly about technical concepts and business implications
• Understanding that the perfect can be the enemy of the good and a desire to not make it so
• Growth mindset and drive to learn with an inclination to get things done
• Can-do attitude, patience when needed, and a good sense of humor! After all, one of Workday’s core values is Fun! This is a particularly fun and friendly team.

Workday Pay Transparency Statement

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location Base Pay Range: $144,000 USD - $216,000 USD

Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $127,500 USD - $216,000 USD

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Job Description We are seeking an AI research fellow to help build Utah's new Office of AI Policy. This role is technical (e.g., using math, computer science, and statistics skills heavily), and will be complemented by other team members with policy, business, and legal expertise. If you are excited at the prospect of joining a small, agile, multidisciplinary team tasked with developing Utah's AI laws and helping AI businesses thrive, please apply!

This position is with the Utah Department of Commerce, Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy. The office was created May 2024 as part of the State of Utah's efforts to lead the nation by systematically developing sensible AI policy across a range of impact areas, such as healthcare, education, and transportation. Central to this new office is the AI Learning Lab, in which key stakeholders (such as industry experts, top academics, and regulators) work toward the right regulatory response to the wide range of applications of AI that businesses wish to pursue in Utah.

The Office also has authority to create regulatory mitigation agreements, which grant businesses enhanced ability to test AI products in Utah while the state gathers data and finds long-term policy solutions. As an AI research fellow on our team, you will augment the Office's existing technical expertise by researching and evaluating a wide range of AI architectures, evaluation strategies, and theories, and how they relate to proposed regulatory solutions. You will also interface with a wide variety of business leaders to understand the main ideas underlying their AI applications and help ensure that the policy stakeholders, such as the state legislators, regulators, and lawyers, are crafting well-reasoned and appropriate responses to these proposed applications.

A hybrid telework schedule may be available if desired, although some regular in-person work will be needed. PRINCIPAL DUTIES Your duties will include but not be limited to the following: Research mathematical, statistical, and computational aspects of AI technologies in support of the Lab's policy agenda. Work extensively with experts in a wide variety of disciplines to understand benefits and risks of AI technologies in Utah.

Advise on the development of regulatory and legal standards as the Office's recommendations move through the legislative process. THE IDEAL CANDIDATE Our model candidate will have: Deep technical knowledge of computational, mathematical, and statistical aspects of artificial intelligence or machine learning. Track record of excellent problem solving and reliability.

Strong interest in AI policy and its business implications. Strong technical communication skills. PREFERENCES We may give preferences for applicants with the following: Strong experience implementing and deploying AI, particularly in a business context.

Expertise in aspects of public policy and/or law. Ability to conduct novel research and develop new AI techniques as needed. WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM This AI Research Fellow will join a small, agile team, developing a new, innovative way of thinking about key AI issues with strong support from the Governor and legislature.

The right candidate will be in a position to influence the development of AI in the state and make substantial impacts on Utah's AI economy, giving the state a competitive edge, while simultaneously ensuring the safety of millions of consumers. This role will also have an outsized influence on the national and global stage as Utah is a first mover in this area. • 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:
• 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
• Proven experience working as an AI architect, data scientist, or related role.
• Strong knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP) techniques.
• Experience in designing and implementing large-scale AI solutions, including data ingestion, storage, processing, and deployment.
• Solid understanding of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and experience deploying AI models on these platforms.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex problems into actionable components.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
• Ability to stay updated with the latest advancements in AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms.
• Knowledge of ethical considerations and responsible AI practices is a plus.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++, and familiarity with popular AI libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras).

Work Hours: Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements: This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.
